metadata.time_definition: relative_s = Unix ROS source time - 1792729000.0; this is 12:16:40 Asia/Shanghai, NOT 12:17:00 and NOT session start.
metadata.alignment: Tick t is status header.stamp. Each tick uses the latest odom/final attitude publication with rosbag receipt t <= status header.stamp; original source and receipt stamps are retained. Bag receipt is a replay availability proxy, not proof of exact callback execution order.
metadata.velocity_definition: Odom twist is in child frame (session.json). vz = R(q)[2,:] dot child linear velocity; vertical_fraction = R(q)[2,2]. Raw quaternion/child velocity are retained in odom_samples.
metadata.range_definition: range_samples contain original optical_flow_rad.distance and its header source and rosbag receipt stamps. ticks.range contains recorded controller range diagnostics, including source-matched projection/filters and validity; these are observations, not regenerated post-fix results.
metadata.nonfinite_values: Recorded NaN/Infinity are JSON null; no missing velocity is replaced by zero.
metadata.replay_limit: Recorded flight motion remains fixed.
